\small

\begin{center}
{\Large\bfseries\color{bsblue} Four intensive R courses in methods for health data science}\\[2pt]
{\large Online · Live cohort · September to October 2026}\\[4pt]
{\bfseries\color{bsblue} Registration is open}
\end{center}

\vspace{4pt}

Four independent, cohort-based courses take participants from applied biostatistics through machine learning, survival analysis, and evidence synthesis, all taught in R with reproducible Quarto workflows. Each course is self-contained: no prerequisite is mandatory, though taking them in order builds a complete methods pathway.

\vspace{2pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\footnotesize Each course: 2 weeks, 8 sessions (16h). Mon/Wed/Fri 18h00-20h00, Sun 10h00-12h00, Morocco time.\normalsize

# The Offer

- **150€ (1500 MAD) per course**, register for any single course, or all four
- Live sessions + slides, notebooks, datasets, and exercises for every session
- Small cohort, direct feedback, exercises corrected in-session
- Ends with a short reproducible Quarto mini-project
- Teaching in French, with English for statistical/technical terms

\vspace{4pt}

# Who it's for

Clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts who want a rigorous, hands-on introduction to modern health data analysis in R. No advanced statistics background required for BIOSTATR; the other three build on it but can be taken independently.
